notes: s016: rule 67 leaves the head open where a complex frame rides on an expressed proper preposition; the head on *after* is taken here and the note records that a head on *manner* stands in the corpus.
The second *not* (t022) is the repetition of a spent οὐχί and is a rule 7/103 helper on the verb it negates — neither `added` nor a rule 15 stretch of οὐχί's unit.
s007: ἐν ὑμῖν is the predicate of the verbless clause, so rules 53 and 96 put the supplied copula and the expletive *there* on the preposition.
